# CodeSparring
# https://www.codesparring.dev

> CodeSparring is an interview-practice platform for software engineers and data engineers. It
> combines a free public curriculum with AI-led coding, debugging, and system-design practice.
> Public lesson reading is available without an account. Graded lesson workspaces and AI interview
> feedback require sign-in; the interview room also offers a limited guest trial.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-04. Volatile quotas, prices, and feature availability belong on the live
[pricing page](https://www.codesparring.dev/pricing), not in this file.

## Public curriculum

- [Learn hub](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn): public Python, Data Engineering, and System
  Design courses.
- [All lessons](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn/all): a flat index of public lessons.
- [Python](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn/python): interview-focused Python fundamentals,
  idioms, applied development, engineering, and code review.
- [Data Engineering](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn/data-engineering): SQL foundations,
  joins, modeling, data quality, cloud data, warehouses, pipelines, streaming/CDC, distributed
  compute, and data for AI.
- [System Design](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn/system-design): interview method, foundations,
  storage, scaling, distributed systems, event-driven systems, reliability, security, modern
  architecture, case studies, and specialized systems.

Public lesson URL pattern: `/learn/{track}/{levelSlug}/{lessonId}`. The lesson's `/workspace` child
is the authenticated, graded surface and is not an indexable public resource. The legacy
`/learn/sql` family redirects to the Data Engineering track.

## Interview practice

- [AI coding interview practice](https://www.codesparring.dev/ai-coding-interview-practice):
  explain an approach, write code against tests, and receive rubric-based feedback.
- [Bug-fix interview practice](https://www.codesparring.dev/bug-fix-interview-practice): debug a
  multi-file codebase with a failing test, explain a hypothesis, and verify the fix.
- [System design interview practice](https://www.codesparring.dev/system-design-interview-practice):
  practice open-ended architecture conversations and tradeoffs.
- [Interview rounds](https://www.codesparring.dev/rounds): overview of debugging and real-world case
  formats.
- [Case Labs](https://www.codesparring.dev/labs): longer, multi-file engineering scenarios.
- [Sample feedback](https://www.codesparring.dev/samples): public examples of scored interview
  reports.
- [Free AI interview](https://www.codesparring.dev/free-ai-coding-interview): current guest and
  free-account access details.

The product supports voice or text interaction, executable coding tasks where the selected runner
supports the language, session feedback, progress tracking, and (on eligible plans) roadmap and
spaced-review features. See the live product pages for current limits and availability.

## Useful public lessons

- [HTTP semantics: methods, status codes, and caching](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn/system-design/foundations/sd-l1-http-semantics): safety, idempotency, conditional requests, and cache headers.
- [HTTP versions](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn/system-design/foundations/sd-l1-http-versions): HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3 tradeoffs.
- [Delivery semantics](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn/system-design/event-driven/sd-l6-delivery-semantics): at-most-once, at-least-once, effectively-once effects, and idempotency boundaries.
- [Retries, DLQs, and backpressure](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn/system-design/event-driven/sd-l6-retries-dlq-backpressure): transient versus permanent failures, retry topics, poison messages, consumer lag, and bounded work.
- [Leader election and fencing](https://www.codesparring.dev/learn/system-design/distributed-core/sd-l5-leader-election-fencing): leases, fencing tokens, split brain, and stale leaders.

These are educational resources, not operational guarantees or vendor-specific product documentation.

## Crawling

- [Sitemap](https://www.codesparring.dev/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://www.codesparring.dev/robots.txt)
- Canonical host: `https://www.codesparring.dev`; the apex redirects to it.
- Public lesson and marketing pages are crawlable. Authenticated and per-user surfaces are
  intentionally excluded from indexing.
